checks.name: A captured R26 revision preserves exact archive and record UTF-8 bytes without inventing original transport
Source revision changes and raw-value changes without a revision invalidate both extraction and verification
A concurrent restore during verification keeps captured results but refuses a verdict for current storage
Selection is bounded and resolved against private records rather than caller-created values
Unknown contracts and repeated IDs remain visible but never become executable
Missing source, malformed nested archive and an empty archive do not invent replays
Cancellation during an asynchronous factory settles without a stale publication and tears down the eventual engine
Closing the bridge refuses later reads and never falls back to game storage

scope: Restored-revision bridge boundaries with original R19/R13 parsers and actual current/historical replay fixtures. Controlled engine tasks test invalidation and cancellation; real browser engine execution is recorded separately.
